en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Adds on-demand device history checks and a permanent recovery section with a choice to keep protection or resume the current mode. Preserves the original incident and records manual recovery choices. Please check reconnection and recovery behavior.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 增加按需设备历史核验及固定的异常处理区，可选择继续保护或恢复当前模式，保留原始异常和手动处理记录。请检查重新连接与恢复表现。
